    '"""Authena: the judge behind a Kleros Curate list of agent skills that are safe to install.\n' +

    'the quote from Sepolia, fetches the file from GitHub at that commit, checks the quote is really in\n' +

    '\n' +
    '# Kleros LightGeneralizedTCR event signatures (keccak256 of the declaration).\n' +

    'SEL_DISPUTE_ITEM = "9c81a827"  # arbitratorDisputeIDToItemID(address,uint256)\n' +
